title: Insurer scorecard: public sample (synthetic evidence)

statement: A summary of the signed evidence supplied for the period, copied and counted without new detection. Each source keeps its own label and validation status. Not an underwriting recommendation, a rating, premium advice or a finding of fact; classes and findings describe the consistency of data, never intent.
